Board lead: I can release some area, but not much. Routability hits 0.95 at about 1197 mm², so my hard floor is 2681 mm³. I'm dropping from 1250 to 1205 mm², which is 2699 mm³ and frees about 101 mm³ with a small routability margin. The interior is over by 1246 mm³, so board cuts alone can't fix it. The rest must come from other domains:
- **Antenna and NFC:** 2000 mm³ combined, which is large. Please justify it or trim it.
- **Acoustics:** 1460 mm³.
- **Structure:** 1800 mm³.
- **Battery:** 3786 mm³. Battery energy also drives both the 60 h runtime and the siren endurance, so it can't be cut freely.

I'll go lower only if someone shows a concrete trade that needs it.

Battery can't fund the gap. At 3786 mm³ and an 800 mm² footprint, runtime is 59.78 h against the ~60 h target, and the same energy sets siren endurance. Any volume I cut comes straight out of both.

Caseback has 23 mm² of slack (1120 of 1143). I'm probing whether a thinner, wider cell or a slightly smaller volume holds runtime.

Asks while the interior is still 1145 mm³ over:
- **Antenna and NFC:** 2000 mm³ combined. Please show what GNSS L5 needs at minimum.
- **Structure:** 1800 mm³ at a 1.2 mm wall.
- **Acoustics:** 1460 mm³ against a 9 mm² port.

I'll move on battery volume only for a concrete trade that keeps runtime and siren endurance whole.

Antenna can't give a number until I see my efficiency curve. L5 efficiency is only 0.208 at 1500 mm³, which is already low, so I won't cut blind. This round I'm probing V_ant at 1200 and 1000, plus a thinner wall.

A thinner titanium wall helps everyone. Each 0.1 mm returned frees 150 mm³ of interior and reduces detuning of my antenna. Structure, please say how thin the wall can go. A 1.0 mm wall would free 300 mm³ and may let me hold L5 with less volume.

NFC, please say what your loop needs inside the 2400 mm³ perimeter. Antenna and NFC currently total 1820 mm³ against that pool.

Thermal is at its limit. At a 1.2 mm wall, 320 mm² (250 mm³) gives exactly 43.0 °C, so I have no slack to give up. Going the other way, each extra 10 mm² costs 7.8 mm³ of interior and caseback area.

Wall thickness affects my result, so I'm probing 1.0 and 1.1 mm. A thinner wall frees 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm for everyone, but it may push my spreader area up. Structure, please give a minimum wall figure backed by your drop and pressure numbers. I'll report the A_spr needed at each wall value next round so the trade is visible.

Structure can't give volume or wall yet. At a 1.2 mm wall, 1800 mm³ of ribs and a 9 mm² port, my pressure margin is 1.438 against the 1.5 requirement, so I'm failing before any cut.

A thinner wall is not available now. Each 0.1 mm of wall is worth 150 mm³ to everyone, so I'm comparing three fixes:
- Add rib volume at the same wall.
- Thicken the wall to 1.3 mm.
- Shrink the port. The port pool is shared and Acoustics owns the port area, so I'm probing it as a what-if.

Next round I'll report margin per mm³ for each and take the cheapest. Acoustics, please say how much port reduction your intelligibility and 86 dB targets can tolerate.

Acoustics objects: the siren fails at 9.08 W against the 1.0 W limit, and endurance is only 0.34 h against 3 h. The cause is that the resonance sits at 5.58 kHz with Q 3.7, so the driver is badly mismatched at the siren frequency. I expect that lowering the resonance and the mesh resistance is the fix. A longer outlet (h_out) and a smaller port should both pull the resonance down.

That means I can probably give up port area, which helps Structure's pressure margin, and some volume. I'm probing three combinations this round and will quote the port and volume I can actually release next round. Until then I'm holding my current claims.

Battery: the siren needs ≤1 W before endurance can be judged, so please hold the 3786 mm³ for now.

Haptics can release volume. My force is 1.069 N at 350 mm³, and the 0.9 N floor is about 295 mm³. I'm dropping to 310 mm³, which should give about 0.95 N with a small margin. That frees 40 mm³ and takes the interior over-claim from 1145 to about 1105 mm³. I'm probing 295 and 300 to confirm the floor, and I may go lower next round if the numbers support it.

I don't use caseback area, perimeter volume, or the port. The remaining ~1100 mm³ has to come from antenna/NFC, acoustics, structure, and the wall trade. I'll trade further only against a concrete ask.

NFC can release volume. My range is 18.2 mm against a 10 mm requirement, so I have a lot of slack. The 500 mm³ is not a hard need, and the bounds allow as little as 290 mm³ (loop 180 plus ferrite 110).

I'm probing three points this round: the floor (180/110), a mid point (250/140), and a loop-heavy point (220/120). Next round I'll claim the smallest total that keeps range at 10 mm or better with margin. I expect to free 150-210 mm³ of interior.

The loop sits in the perimeter keepout, and the loop's share of the 1820 mm³ currently claimed against the 2400 pool will shrink. NFC uses no caseback area and no port. I'm holding my claims until the probe results are in.

Board lead: I'm trimming from 1205 to 1200 mm², or 2688 mm³. That frees 11 mm³ and leaves routability at about 0.953. 1197 mm² (2681 mm³) is the hard floor, and 1180 mm² fails at 0.937, so I won't go lower.

The interior is still over by about 1100 mm³, so I can't accept the ledger yet. My cuts are nearly exhausted, and the remaining gap has to come from these sources:
- **NFC:** the 150-210 mm³ it has offered.
- **Antenna:** a justified trim, or a thinner wall.
- **Acoustics:** the volume it said it can release.
- **Structure:** a fix that doesn't add rib volume or wall.

The wall trade is worth more than all of my cuts combined: 0.1 mm is 150 mm³.

Battery can't fund the gap. Runtime is about 0.0158 h per mm³ (3700 mm³ gives 58.42 h, 3786 gives 59.78 h), so 60 h needs about 3800 mm³. Every mm³ I cut costs runtime and siren energy.

Footprint doesn't change runtime: 800 and 840 mm² both give 59.78 h at 3786 mm³. Footprint only sets cell thickness. At 800 mm² the cell is 4.73 mm, and the 4.8 mm limit stops me going below about 790 mm². I could go up to 840 mm² if caseback area is needed, but I can't release any.

The ~1094 mm³ over-claim has to come from:
- NFC, which offered 150-210 mm³.
- Antenna, once its efficiency curve is known.
- Acoustics, which should say how much volume it will release.
- A wall change.

I'm holding my claims and will OBJECT while the interior is over.

Antenna holds 1500 mm³ this round. My L5 curve is steep and getting steeper:

| V_ant (mm³) | L5 efficiency |
|---|---|
| 1000 | 0.093 |
| 1200 | 0.133 |
| 1500 | 0.208 |

- **Cost of cutting:** each 100 mm³ I give up costs about 0.02-0.025 of efficiency, so a 300 mm³ cut loses about a third of L5.
- **Where the gap should come from:** my 1500 mm³ is the wrong place to look. NFC's offered ~200 mm³ and Acoustics' port and volume release come first.
- **Wall:** at 1200 mm³, going from 1.2 mm to 1.0 mm lifts L5 from 0.133 to 0.146. That is worth having, but only if Structure can close its pressure margin another way, such as a smaller port.
- **Perimeter:** this is not binding. Once NFC shrinks, antenna plus NFC will sit well under the 2400 mm³ pool.

This round I'm probing 1400 mm³ at the current wall, and 1500 mm³ at 1.1 mm and at 1.0 mm. I'll OBJECT while the interior is over.

Thermal's results across the wall range:

| Wall (mm) | A_spr (mm²) | Skin temp (°C) |
|---|---|---|
| 1.2 | 320 | 43.00 |
| 1.1 | 320 | 42.99 |
| 1.0 | 320 | 42.97 |
| 1.0 | 380 | 42.40 |

- **Wall:** Thinning it does not hurt me and helps slightly. If Structure can close its pressure margin another way, such as a smaller port, I support 1.0-1.1 mm. That frees 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm for everyone.
- **Area:** I can't release any at the current 1.2 mm wall, since 320 mm² is exactly 43.0 °C. At 1.0 mm the slack is about 3 mm² (~2 mm³), which is negligible.
- **Sensitivity:** about 0.0095 °C per mm², so each 10 mm² costs 7.8 mm³.
- **Probes:** this round I'm probing 1.3 mm in case Structure thickens the wall, and trims at 1.0 mm.

I OBJECT because the interior is over by about 1094 mm³, not because of my own numbers.

Structure here. My probes from last round show what each fix is worth:

| Fix | Pressure margin | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| +200 mm³ ribs | +0.016 | Nearly useless |
| Wall 1.3 mm | +0.197 | 150 mm³ for everyone |
| Port 9 → 7 mm² | +0.124 | Free to me, but Acoustics owns it |

The port is the cheapest fix. The ribs are also nearly insensitive, so cutting ribs from 1800 to 1400 mm³ should cost only about 0.03 margin. That could release up to 400 mm³ once the port is at 7 mm² or below.

**Ask:** Acoustics, please commit to a port of 7 mm² or less. That also leaves room to thin the wall.

This round I'm probing three combinations:
- Ribs at 1400 mm³, wall 1.2 mm, port 7 mm².
- Ribs at 1500 mm³, wall 1.1 mm, port 5 mm².
- Ribs at 1400 mm³, wall 1.0 mm, port 4 mm².

I'm holding my

Acoustics: I commit to port ≤ 6 mm² now, which helps Structure's margin. Structure can plan on 7 mm² or less.

Last round's probes show what moves the siren power:
- Cutting the port from 9 to 6 mm², lengthening the outlet to 2.5 mm and dropping the mesh to 20 rayl cut siren

Haptics: I'm dropping from 310 to 300 mm³, which frees another 10 mm³. My probes give force of 0.901 N at 295, 0.916 N at 300 and 0.947 N at 310, so about 0.003 N per mm³. 300 mm³ leaves 0.016 N of margin over the 0.9 N floor. I won't go to 295, because that leaves only 0.001 N of margin and any model error would breach the floor.

The remaining over-claim is about 1080 mm³, and it has to come from these sources:
- **NFC:** the 150-210 mm³ it offered.
- **Acoustics and Structure:** the port cut, which lets Structure trim ribs by up to 400 mm³.
- **Wall:** thinning it, which frees 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm.

I still can't accept the ledger while the interior is over, so I OBJECT. I'm not objecting on my own numbers.

NFC is releasing 210 mm³ now. I'm claiming the floor of 180 mm³ loop and 110 mm³ ferrite, 290 mm³ total, down from 500. My probe at that point gave 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, so I keep 2.7 mm of margin (about 27%). I can't go lower because the bounds stop me.

This takes the interior over-claim from about 1084 to about 874 mm³. Perimeter use falls to 1790 mm³ of the 2400 mm³ pool, so antenna has no perimeter constraint.

The rest has to come from these sources:
- **Structure:** ribs can drop up to 400 mm³ once Acoustics' port is at 6 mm² or less.
- **Wall:** thinning it frees 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm.
- **Acoustics:** it has said it will release some volume.

I use no caseback area and no port. I'm probing 180/150 and 220/110 to show which of loop or ferrite gives range more cheaply, in case a trade is needed later. I OBJECT only because the interior is still over, not because of m

Board lead: I'm holding 1200 mm² (2688 mm³, routability 0.952). 1197 mm² is the hard floor, at exactly 0.950 with no margin, so I'm not cutting further. I could take 1198 mm² and free 4.5 mm³, which isn't worth the risk.

The interior is still over by 874 mm³. Here is a path that closes it:
- **Structure:** with the port at 6 mm² or less, ribs drop by about 400 mm³.
- **Wall:** 1.0 mm frees about 300 mm³ for everyone.
- **Remaining ~175 mm³:** Acoustics should release it (it holds 1460 mm³), or Antenna should give a small trim.

Structure, please confirm that the wall can reach 1.0–1.1 mm with the 6 mm² port and ribs at about 1400 mm³. I OBJECT only because the interior is over, not because of my own numbers.

Battery holds 3786 mm³ at 800 mm². That gives 59.78 h and a 4.73 mm cell, which is inside the 4.8 mm limit and the z-stack. I can't release volume: each mm³ costs about 0.0158 h of runtime and some siren energy.

I agree with Board's path:
- Structure cuts ribs by about 400 mm³ once the port is at 6 mm² or less.
- The wall goes to 1.0-1.1 mm, which frees 150 mm³ per 0.1 mm.
- Acoustics releases the remaining ~175 mm³.

If the wall closes the gap with any slack left over, I'd take 14 mm³ to reach 3800 mm³ and 60.0 h. Footprint stays at 800 mm², because 830 mm² would push the caseback to 1150 mm², over the 1143 mm² pool.

I OBJECT only because the interior is over, not because of my own numbers.

Antenna: I'm holding 1500 mm³ and supporting the plan Board and Battery laid out. Ribs drop about 400 mm³ with the port at 6 mm² or less, and the wall goes to 1.0-1.1 mm, which frees 300 mm³ at 1.0 mm. Acoustics then releases the last ~175 mm³ or less.

The thinner wall also helps me. At 1500 mm³, L5 efficiency rises from 0.208 at 1.2 mm to 0.217 at 1.1 mm and 0.227 at 1.0 mm. The perimeter pool is not binding, with 1790 mm³ in use of 2400.

I'd rather not trim, because each 100 mm³ costs about 0.027 of L5. If the wall closes the gap, any leftover slack should go to Battery's 14 mm³ first. I'm probing 1450 mm³ and 1600 mm³ at a 1.0 mm wall to price a small trade.

I OBJECT only because the interior is still over by 874 mm³, not because of my own numbers.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³). Skin temperature is 43.00 °C at the 1.2 mm wall, 42.99 °C at 1.1 mm and 42.97 °C at 1.0 mm, so my requirement is met at every wall under discussion. I support the plan Board laid out: the port at 6 mm² or less, ribs cut by about 400 mm³ and the wall at 1.0-1.1 mm.

I can't go below 318 mm² at 1.0 mm. The 316 mm² probe already failed at 43.02 °C. If the wall stays at 1.2 mm I have zero margin, and each extra 10 mm² would buy 0.095 °C for 7.8 mm³. I can offer that margin later if it is wanted.

I OBJECT only because the interior is still over by 874 mm³, not because of my own numbers.

Acoustics: I OBJECT because my own siren requirement fails. At the current claims the siren needs 9.08 W against the 1.0 W limit, so endurance is only 0.34 h.

I'm moving to the fixes that last round's probes pointed to:
- **Port:** 6 mm², as committed. Structure can plan on 7 mm² or less.
- **Mesh:** 20 rayl, the minimum.
- **Outlet:** lengthened to 2.5 mm.

I'm also releasing 160 mm³ (1460 → 1300). That is not yet the full ~175 mm³ Board asked for. I can't release more until I see whether the siren closes at this volume, because siren power and SII both depend on volume.

I'm probing a longer outlet, a different split, and the full 1460 mm³ to price what the volume release costs. The interior stays over by about 714 mm³ until Structure's ribs and the wall move.

Haptics: I'm holding 300 mm³. Force is 0.916 N against the 0.9 N floor, with 0.016 N of margin. My requirement is met, and I use no caseback area, port or perimeter.

The interior is still over by 714 mm³, so I OBJECT on the ledger, not on my own numbers. The gap should close as follows:
- **Structure:** ribs drop about 400 mm³ now that the port is 6 mm² or less. I need Structure to state the ribs figure and the wall it can accept.
- **Wall:** each 0.1 mm thinner frees 150 mm³.
- **Acoustics:** any further release depends on whether the siren closes.

If a final squeeze is needed, I can go to 297 mm³ (0.907 N), which frees 3 mm³. I won't go lower. I'm probing 297, 298 and 300 mm³ to keep that option priced.

NFC: I'm holding 180 mm³ loop and 110 mm³ ferrite, 290 mm³ in total. Both are at their lower bounds, so I have nothing more to release. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm requirement, so my requirement is met. I use no caseback area or port, and perimeter use stays well inside the pool.

The interior is still over by 714 mm³. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers. The closing items are:
- **Structure:** it hasn't posted its numbers this round. I need its ribs figure (about 1400 mm³ with the port at 6 mm²) and the wall it will accept.
- **Wall:** each 0.1 mm thinner frees 150 mm³ for everyone.
- **Acoustics:** it still has to say whether the siren closes at 1300 mm³.

I won't take any slack back.

Board: I'm holding 1200 mm² (2688 mm³, routability 0.952). The hard floor is about 1197.5 mm² at exactly 0.950, so I won't go below 1198 mm² (0.951). That would free only 4.5 mm³ and I'd rather keep the margin. If the final squeeze comes down to a few mm³, I'll release it then.

The ledger is still over by 714 mm³, and Structure hasn't posted. The gap closes like this:
- **Structure:** ribs drop about 400 mm³ now that the port is 6 mm² or less. I need Structure to state its ribs figure and the wall it accepts.
- **Wall:** 1.0 mm frees 300 mm³, and 1.1 mm frees 150 mm³.
- **Acoustics:** it holds 1300 mm³ and has already released 160, so it should say whether the siren closes.

400 + 300 covers the 714 mm³ gap with about 14 mm³ to spare, which matches Battery's 14 mm³ request. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ at 800 mm², which gives 59.78 h and a 4.73 mm cell, so my own numbers pass. I can't release any volume. Each mm³ costs about 0.0158 h, and Acoustics' siren endurance also depends on the battery energy.

The interior is still over by 714 mm³, and Structure still hasn't posted. Board's path closes it:
- **Ribs:** about 400 mm³ saved with the port at 6 mm² or less.
- **Wall:** 1.0 mm frees about 300 mm³.
- **Leftover:** about 14 mm³, which I'd take to reach 3800 mm³ and 60.0 h.

Structure, please state your ribs figure and the wall you accept. Acoustics, please say whether the siren closes at 1300 mm³. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Antenna: I'm holding 1500 mm³. The numbers from my last probes:
- **L5 at 1500 mm³:** 0.208 at a 1.2 mm wall, 0.222 at 1.05 mm and about 0.227 at 1.0 mm.
- **Cost of trimming:** dropping to 1450 mm³ at a 1.0 mm wall gives 0.213, so about 0.014 of L5 for 50 mm³.
- **Perimeter:** 1790 mm³ of 2400 mm³ is in use, so it isn't binding.

I support the plan. The gap closes with ribs down about 400 mm³ and the wall at 1.0 mm, which frees 300 mm³. Acoustics then covers the remainder. Structure still hasn't posted its ribs figure or the wall it accepts, and that is what decides this round. If a few mm³ remain after that, Battery's 14 mm³ comes first. I'd trim only as a last resort.

I OBJECT on the ledger (still over by 714 mm³), not on my own numbers.

Thermal: I'm holding 320 mm² (250 mm³). Skin temperature is 43.00 °C at a 1.2 mm wall, 42.99 °C at 1.1 mm and 42.97 °C at 1.0 mm, so my requirement is met at every wall under discussion.

- **Release:** at a 1.0 mm wall, 318 mm² is the floor at exactly 43.00 °C. That frees only about 1.6 mm³ with no margin, so I'll offer it only if the final squeeze needs it.
- **Wall:** a thinner wall doesn't hurt me. Structure, please confirm 1.0-1.1 mm with ribs of about 1400 mm³ at the 6 mm² port.
- **Gap:** the ledger is still over by 714 mm³, so I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers. Acoustics, please say whether the siren closes at 1300 mm³.

I'm probing 319 mm² at 1.0 mm, 320 mm² at 1.0 mm and 318 mm² at 1.05 mm to keep the release options priced.

Structure: I'm moving first, but I haven't yet seen the pressure margin for the new combinations. At the current 1800 mm³ ribs and 1.2 mm wall with the 6 mm² port, margin is 1.625 (≥1.5 required).

- **Ribs:** I'm claiming 1400 mm³, the bound. That releases 400 mm³.
- **Wall:** I'm claiming 1.1 mm, which frees 150 mm³. I won't commit to 1.0 mm until I've seen the margin there.
- **Gap:** that leaves the interior about 164 mm³ over. If 1.0 mm passes, it closes to about 14 mm³ over, which Acoustics' remaining release or small trims would cover.
- **Port:** the port must stay at or below 6 mm². Please don't raise it.

I'm probing 1400/1.0, 1400/1.05 and 1500/1.0, plus the port, to find where margin holds. I OBJECT for now because the ledger is over and my 1.0 mm margin is unverified.

Acoustics: the siren is still not closed. At 1300 mm³ it draws 7.25 W with split 0.78, so I OBJECT on my own requirement.

- **Split is the lever.** Moving it to 0.60 cut power from 7.25 W to 2.13 W and resonance from 4986 Hz to 3693 Hz. SII fell from 87.3 to 84.3.
- **Outlet length does nothing here.** 3.2 mm and 2.5 mm gave identical results, so I'm leaving it at 2.5 mm.
- **Volume is not the lever.** Even the full 1460 mm³ only reached 5.4 W, so I can't free more mm³ until the power closes.

I'm claiming split 0.60 and probing 0.50, 0.45 and a 5 mm² port at split 0.55 to find where power reaches 1.0 W. Once it closes I'll release what I can toward the remaining 164 mm³.

Haptics: my numbers pass at 300 mm³ (0.916 N against the 0.9 N floor). The ledger is still over by 164 mm³, so I OBJECT on the ledger only.

- **Release:** I'm giving back 2 mm³ now, claiming 298 mm³ (0.910 N). That is as far as I'll go without a firm need. 297 mm³ (0.907 N) is the last step, and I'll take it only if it closes the ledger exactly.
- **Wall:** if Structure's margin holds at 1.0 mm, the gap drops to about 14 mm³ over. My 3 mm³ plus Board's 4.5 mm³ and Thermal's 1.6 mm³ would then cover most of it.
- **Acoustics:** the siren still has to close before it can release volume.

NFC: my requirement is met. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm floor, using 180 mm³ loop and 110 mm³ ferrite. Both are at their lower bounds, so I have no volume left to release.

The ledger is over by 162 mm³ at the 1.1 mm wall. Here is what closes it:
- **Wall:** 1.0 mm frees about 150 mm³, which depends on Structure's pressure margin.
- **Small releases:** Haptics 1-3 mm³, Board 4.5 mm³ and Thermal 1.6 mm³ cover most of what remains.
- **Acoustics:** it needs to close the siren (split 0.60 gives 2.13 W against the 1.0 W limit) before it can release more.

I'm not asking for any extra volume. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Board: I'm releasing now and claiming 1198 mm² (2683.5 mm³, routability 0.951). That frees 4.5 mm³ and still leaves a 0.001 margin over the 0.950 floor. The last step is 1197.5 mm² at exactly 0.950, and I'll take it only if it closes the ledger exactly. Below that I fail my own requirement, so I can't go lower.

The ledger is still about 157 mm³ over, and that gap is not mine to close. It closes only if Structure's pressure margin holds at a 1.0 mm wall, which frees 150 mm³. Acoustics' siren also has to close before it can release volume. Structure, please post the margin at 1400 mm³ ribs and a 1.0 mm wall. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Battery: I'm holding 3786 mm³ at 800 mm². That gives 59.78 h and a 4.73 mm cell, and the z-stack passes, so my own numbers pass. I'm withdrawing my 14 mm³ request. Closing the interior gap matters more than 0.2 h, and I'd rather trade it than add to the over-claim.

The ledger is still 157 mm³ over, and it closes in two steps:
- **Structure:** it must post the pressure margin at 1400 mm³ ribs and a 1.0 mm wall. That frees 150 mm³.
- **Acoustics:** the siren must close so it can release volume.

A wider footprint doesn't cost volume, so if the caseback has room I can trade area for thickness. I OBJECT on the ledger only.

Antenna: I'm holding 1500 mm³. L5 is 0.217 at a 1.1 mm wall and 0.227 at 1.0 mm, so a thinner wall helps me as well as the pool.

- **Gap:** the ledger is 157 mm³ over. Structure's 1.0 mm wall frees about 150 mm³ and is the real closer. Structure, please post the pressure margin at 1400 mm³ ribs and a 1.0 mm wall.
- **Trimming:** trimming costs me about 0.0003 L5 per mm³ (1480 mm³ at 1.05 mm gives 0.216 against 0.222 at 1500). I'd only trim as a last resort, and only after Haptics' 1 mm³, Board's 0.5 mm³ and Thermal's 1.6 mm³ small releases.
- **Acoustics:** you need to close the siren before you can release volume.

I'm probing 1490 mm³ and 1450 mm³ at 1.0 mm to price the final squeeze. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Thermal: my numbers pass at 320 mm² (250 mm³), with skin temperature at 42.99 °C at the 1.1 mm wall. My probes show a thinner wall helps me:
- **1.0 mm wall:** 42.97 °C at 320 mm² and 42.98 °C at 319 mm².
- **1.05 mm wall:** 318 mm² fails (reads 43.00 and is flagged not ok), so 318 is too tight at any wall above 1.0 mm.

Releasing area is worth almost nothing: 1 mm² frees only 0.78 mm³. I'll give 1-2 mm² only once the wall is confirmed at 1.0 mm.

The ledger is 157 mm³ over. The real closer is Structure's margin at 1400 mm³ ribs and a 1.0 mm wall, and Acoustics also has to close the siren before it can release volume. Structure, please post that margin.

I'm probing 319 mm² at 1.1 mm, 319 mm² at 1.05 mm, and 318 mm² at 1.0 mm. I OBJECT on the ledger only, not on my own numbers.

Structure: I have to retract last round's hope. My margin at 1400 mm³ ribs, 1.1 mm wall and the 6 mm² port is 1.402, so I fail the 1.5 requirement. My probes show the wall is the real lever:

| Wall | Margin (1400 mm³ ribs, 6 mm² port) |
|---|---|

Acoustics: the siren still fails, and my probes show port is the lever left.

- **Split:** it bottoms out near 0.5 at about 2.04 W, with SII 82.1. Below that, power rises again.
- **Port:** at 5 mm² power rose to 2.64 W, against about 2.04 W at 6 mm². A larger port should cut power, but that conflicts with Structure's pressure margin.
- **Endurance:** 1.0 W gives only about 2.9 h at today's battery, so I need roughly 0.9 W or less.
- **Volume:** I can't release any until the siren closes.

I'm probing ports of 8 and 10 mm² at split 0.5, and 8 mm² at 1100 mm³ to price the volume release. Structure, please post your margin versus port at the 1.0 mm wall.

Haptics: my numbers pass at 298 mm³ (0.910 N against the 0.9 N floor). The ledger is still 157 mm³ over, so I OBJECT on the ledger only.

- **Gap:** my few mm³ can't close it. The real blockers are Structure's pressure margin and the siren.
- **Structure:** your margin at 1400 mm³ ribs fails at 1.1 mm, and the table was cut off. Please post the margin versus wall and port, including any wall that passes with ribs between 1400 and 1800 mm³. That decides whether we should trade rib volume against wall thickness.
- **Acoustics:** a larger port may close the siren, but it costs Structure margin. Please settle that trade first.
- **Release:** my probes showed 296 mm³ gives 0.904 N, which still passes. I'll step down to 296 once the other numbers are firm enough that the last few mm³ decide the ledger. I won't go below 296.

NFC: my requirement is met. Read range is 12.7 mm against the 10 mm floor, with loop 180 mm³ and ferrite 110 mm³ both at their lower bounds, so I have nothing left to release. NFC volume stays at 290 mm³.

- **Gap:** the interior is 157 mm³ over, and it cannot close from small releases alone. Structure's margin and Acoustics' siren decide it.
- **Structure:** please post the margin at 1.0 mm wall against rib volume and port, since the table was cut off.
- **Acoustics:** if a larger port closes the siren, we need to know what it costs Structure before judging the interior.
